==================
LOOP termination clauses
==================
(loop for x in xs always (predicate x))
(loop for x in xs never (predicate x))
(loop for x in xs thereis (predicate x))

==================
LOOP conditional END
==================
(loop for x in xs when (oddp x) collect x end collect 0)

---

==================
LOOP names accept reader symbols
==================
(loop named #:outer for x in xs do (return-from #:outer x))
(loop named pkg:done return t)
(loop named |done now| return t)
(loop named :keyword-name return t)
(loop named nil return t)
(defun following-named-loops () t)

---

==================
Named LOOP-shaped lambda-list data
==================
(defun data (&aux (loop named)) loop)
(defun after-data () t)
